capabilities: Export the active note to a standalone HTML file
Render a sidebar table of contents with scroll-spy and section search
Render LaTeX math offline with KaTeX
Embed local images as Base64 in the HTML file
Configure dark/light theme, properties card and code-copy buttons
extras: The README is bilingual (Spanish and English) and says community-plugin listing is 'coming soon' (Proximamente), so installation currently relies on manual release downloads; the author accepts donations via Buy Me a Coffee.
problem: Obsidian's built-in exporting produces plain documents without interactive navigation, offline math rendering or a portable single-file layout.
summary: HTML exporter that converts a note into a self-contained, responsive HTML file with a scroll-spy table of contents, KaTeX math, properties and embedded images.
